headline: Bank Strike Dates 2026: Major Bank Employee Strike From September to October, Union Insists on 5-Day Banking and Other Demands
summary: Bank unions have announced a nationwide strike from September to October. They are demanding a five-day banking week and withdrawal of the revised PLI scheme.
why: Indian public and private banks are core lenders to the economy, so strikes can disrupt branch operations, clearing and credit flows. Labour disputes in the sector are watched by bank investors.
